$comment: Recipes for the vplan coverpoints that are NOT timing-spacing points (those come from sva_rules.json via coverage_gen.py). Each coverpoint names a recipe; block_coverage_gen.py turns recipes into SystemVerilog covergroups bound into the named block. Everything a recipe references is checked against the block's manifest at generation time — a port that does not exist is a loud generation failure, never a silently absent bin.

$recipes.occurred: One 'occurred' bin. Fires when `expr` (over the block's ports) is true, or when the `iface` stream's qualifier fires — optionally only for `command` (resolved through the catalog's command_encoding).
$recipes.register_access: One bin per register in the spec's register map whose access type is in `access` (or, with field_level, that contains a field of that type), sampled on writes (`on: write`) or reads (`on: read`) to the register bus.
$recipes.cross_pattern: Cross of the named register_access coverpoint with the module's write-data pattern coverpoint (zeros / ones / 0xA5.. / 0x5A.. / other).
$recipes.first_read_after_reset: One bin per register: a read that happens before any write to that register since reset — the reset-value check actually happened.
$recipes.unmapped_access: One 'occurred' bin: any access to an offset the register map does not declare.
$recipes.access_violation_attempt: One 'occurred' bin: a write to a read-only register, or a read of a register that contains only write-only fields — the antecedent of CSR_001.

cp_ref_001_exercised.why: Starvation antecedent: a refresh is pending and the postpone budget is exhausted. Only then can REF_001 be violated or upheld.

cp_ref_002_exercised.why: A REFRESH issued while at least one bank is active — the situation REF_002 forbids. Observed at bank_tracker, the one block that sees both the command and bank state.

cp_init_001_exercised.why: A mode-register command was issued; ordering (INIT_001) can only be judged once there is an order to judge.

cp_init_002_exercised.why: The init sequence ran to completion, so every inter-step delay (INIT_002) has been exercised.

cp_proto_001_exercised.why: A CAS was issued; PROTO_001 (CAS to an idle bank) is only checkable once CAS commands exist.

cp_proto_002_exercised.why: An ACTIVATE was issued; PROTO_002 (double activate) needs at least one.

cp_data_001_exercised.why: A read response reached the host side, so read data was compared (DATA_001).

cp_data_002_exercised.why: A read was issued, so read latency was measurable (DATA_002).
